name: rap-native-smoke
description: RAP-Smoke's 3-D smoke (awp130bgrb MASSDEN on its 50 hybrid levels, with the pressure and temperature of the same levels): operational HRRR v4's smoke lateral boundaries (have_bcs_chem = .true.; exhrrr_makebc.sh runs real.exe on RAP awp130bgrb, hrrr_vtable MASSDEN 0/20/0 level 105 -> smoke_gc -> chem(p_smoke)). Edge values only when the smoke row's entry says so.

grid.earth_radius_provenance: GRIB2 shape of the earth 6 (6,371,229 m sphere) in RAP's awp130 records, as HRRR. spacing_deg only rounds the request area.

vertical.remap_note: HRRR's hybrid levels carry their own pressure (PRES on level type 105), so no A/B coefficients are needed: the source pressure is that field, the lowest level sits in the surface slot at the surface pressure, and the column goes onto the frame's total hydrostatic half-level pressure, as for CAMS.

acquisition.latency_note: planning allowance for an hourly RAP cycle's awp130bgrb files to be posted, not a measured guarantee; RAP runs to f21 every hour and f51 at 03/09/15/21Z

conversion_parameters.provenance: UPP 1296eebb295251d0fe1cc697f47058c62d887977 MDLFLD.f:2442; params.F:57; no humidity factor

units_epochs.provenance: NOAA RAP awp130bgrb f00 MASSDEN (0/20/0, level 105, same kg m-3 label) read by .idx byte range: rap.20211221 t13z hybrid level 1 median 7.8e-03, max 6.2e+00 (ug m-3); t14z median 8.0e-12, max 5.4e-09 (kg m-3). HRRR wrfnat switches at the same cycle.

attribution: NOAA RAP-Smoke, NOAA Open Data Dissemination
provenance: https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-rap/; rap.tHHz.awp130bgrbfFF.grib2 carries MASSDEN, PRES and TMP on 50 hybrid levels (level type 105) and surface PRES (inventory checked 2026-10-21 on rap.20261020 t06z f01: MASSDEN:1..50 hybrid level). HRRR v4.1.21 smoke LBCs: scripts/conus/exhrrr_makebc.sh, parm hrrr_vtable MASSDEN line, registry.smoke smoke_gc. Inverse density as hrrr-native-smoke (UPP MDLFLD.f:2442, params.F:57).
